plugin.name: L.A. Rush Widescreen Fix
ResX.description: Output width in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Takes effect after a restart.
ResY.description: Output height in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Takes effect after a restart.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the publisher, studio and technology logo videos and the legal screen. The intro movie stays. Takes effect when the game starts.
Fix2D.description: Keeps HUD graphics, text and menus in their 4:3 proportions and maps the mouse to them. Takes effect after a restart.
